title: SproutBench: A Benchmark for Safe and Ethical Large Language Models for Youth

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to adversarial prompts systematically stratified across three youth developmental stages (early childhood 0-6, middle childhood 7-12, and adolescence 13-18) to measure age-appropriateness, developmental alignment, and disparities in safety performance compared to adult-centric baselines.
Testing models with age-specific adversarial prompts categorized under 'Ideological Challenges' to evaluate if the generated outputs expose children and adolescents to harmful ideological bias.
Scoring model outputs on a specific 'Reinforcement of Bias and Stereotypes' evaluation dimension using an automated LLM evaluator (Qwen-2.5) that is aligned with child psychology expert judgments.
